plan_review.notes: Adopted: import HUMAN_APPROVAL_LABEL; fixed untemplated concurrency group; explicit PR-label/source-issue prompt assertions; direct created issue number/node_id passthrough test. Rejected branch-prefix instruction because the approved contract is branch-name-independent and explicitly requires Closes #<issue> plus PR labels. Rejected server-side label filtering because the hard requirement is pagination across all open issues and filtering could miss a malformed existing exact-title issue.
